metadata.title: DNS Observability and Telemetry

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for providing visibility into DNS behavior to support detection, investigation, assurance, and adaptive response.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: DNS telemetry, resolver state metrics, query logs, validation results, and failure indicators.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Defines how DNS behavior is observed and surfaced for security operations without embedding enforcement logic at the DNS platform layer.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for operational guidance on monitoring DNS behavior, detecting DNSSEC validation failures, and managing DNS under adverse conditions, as described in Sections 6 (Operational Considerations) and 7 (Deployment and Management).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for cyber resiliency guidance related to Detect and Adapt objectives, emphasizing monitoring, feedback, learning, and adjustment of defensive posture, as described in Section 3.4 and Section 4.5.

metadata.remarks: DNS Observability and Telemetry defines the visibility required to detect DNS trust degradation, misconfiguration, or attack, and to support investigative and adaptive response. This pattern treats DNS telemetry as security-relevant evidence rather than operational exhaust.

components.title: DNS Query Telemetry
components.description: Collection and exposure of DNS query and response activity to support monitoring and investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of DNS as a command-and-control or covert communication channel.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Analysis of DNS traffic patterns to detect anomalous or malicious behavior.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS query and response events are logged at a level sufficient to support analysis and investigation.

components.title: DNS Validation and Failure Telemetry
components.description: Visibility into DNS validation results, failures, and error conditions that may indicate attack or misconfiguration.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Compromise or manipulation of DNS infrastructure to induce validation failures or inconsistent resolution.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Monitoring and correlation of validation failures and error states to identify trust degradation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS validation failures and anomalous error conditions are monitored to support detection of potential compromise.

components.title: DNS Investigation and Assurance Support
components.description: Preservation and correlation of DNS telemetry to support incident response, forensic analysis, and assurance activities.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Attempts to obscure or erase evidence of malicious activity within DNS infrastructure.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Retention and protection of DNS telemetry to support post-incident analysis and assurance.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS-related records are retained to support analysis, investigation, and assurance requirements.
